title: P3 method branch transfer and training gate attribution
question: Does the localization benefit reach the deployment branch, and which augmented targets and official assignment slots receive auxiliary supervision?

protocol.checkpoint_scope: Existing official pretrained, full-data seed-0 baseline and IG-P3 checkpoints; no optimizer updates
protocol.branch_evaluation: Both final checkpoints on both one-to-many+NMS and one-to-one; same frozen 438 targets and all 5000 raw COCO val2017 images. Prior one-to-one native-val exports are reused; one-to-many uses the same validator settings with explicit end2end=False and COCO category IDs.
protocol.target_endpoint: Raw geometry, class correctness, final GT-associated box/mask IoU, coverage, purity, boundary F1 and threshold attainment; conditional paired bootstrap, not unique detection recall
protocol.gate_panel: 384 anchor training images: 256 randomly selected non-pilot images plus 128 randomly selected pilot images, fixed seed 20260915. Official full training augmentation pool. Identical augmented tensors supplied to initial, baseline and method students; fixed initial teacher. Diagnostic Mosaic source indices are drawn uniformly over full train2017, avoiding a small replay buffer; augmentation probabilities and image/label transforms retain the official recipe. This is not an exact reconstruction of training minibatches.
protocol.gate_endpoint: Eligibility, neighbor presence, original-teacher versus edited-teacher response at the same location, student all-candidate failure, official assigner ownership, and local output-gradient agreement for native detection versus auxiliary loss
protocol.scope_limit: Frozen-checkpoint diagnostic replay, not a reconstruction of gate frequency throughout the completed training. BatchNorm student training statistics are used only in memory; no checkpoint is saved or updated. Teacher uses frozen BatchNorm as in training.
protocol.run_policy: Separate smoke and actual runs. Runtime branch assertions and official category/image/segmentation-area checks. Run logs and partial failures preserved. No long training launched by this diagnostic.

result_scope: Both branches on all 5000 val2017 images and 438 frozen targets; 384 augmented train anchors, 337 selected targets, three fixed students; no training. Supports deployment-transfer and assignment-alignment diagnostics, not efficacy of a revised method.
